prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished Google Play feature graphic for SproutPace, a home microgreens growing planner. Wide landscape composition with EXACT target aspect ratio 1024:500 (2.048:1), ideally output 2048x1000. The attached image is the approved app icon and BRAND IDENTITY reference: faithfully preserve its distinctive two-tone asymmetric sprout, connected tiny central leaf and shallow tray whenever reproducing the logo. Brand palette forest green #105C3B, leaf lime #A5D66D, ivory #FAF8F0. Opaque edge-to-edge background. Exact text, only: "SproutPace". Elegant highly legible humanist sans serif lettering, accurately spelled with uppercase S and P. All logo and text within generous central safe margins, at least 8% from edges. No screenshots, no phone mockups, no store badges, no ratings, no superlatives, no buttons, no additional text, no watermark. Professional botanical identity for a practical calm home cultivation app. Variant 1: Minimal premium brand composition. Warm ivory full-bleed background with a very subtle oversized pale botanical curve at the far right. Faithful original sprout logo on the left, clean forest-green SproutPace wordmark to its right, perfectly balanced horizontal lockup. Excellent negative space, visually deliberate and refined. Flat graphic aesthetic, clean edges, no shadows or 3D. The logo and title are the heroes.
